Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the film and director by conflating the 1933 Austrian-German film “Gently My Songs Entreat” (Leise flehen meine Lieder) directed by Willi Forst with the later British film “Unfinished Symphony” (1934) involving Anthony Asquith. Despite the WebSurfer’s initial result correctly identifying Willi Forst as the director, the Planner pivoted to Anthony Asquith and pursued his birthplace, leading away from the correct answer (Vienna/Viennese) tied to Willi Forst.
